description: Run a cache purge (invalidation) on a Global Edge CDN edge. Supports purging all content, by directory, pattern, or specific URLs. Returns a purge request ID (check with ncloud_edge_get_purge_request).

edgeId.description: Edge ID to purge cache for

purgeTarget.description: Purge target list (omit for ALL type). DIRECTORY: /path/*, PATTERN: /path/*.ext, URL: /path/file.ext

purgeType.description: Purge type: ALL (purge everything), DIRECTORY (by directory path), PATTERN (directory + extension), URL (specific files)

name: ncloud_edge_purge
